Snapshot manifest message types, constants, and slot conversion helpers.

# Purpose
This header defines the snapshot message and manifest data used by the restore utilities. It declares message signatures for snapshot control messages such as `FD_SSMSG_MANIFEST_FULL`, `FD_SSMSG_MANIFEST_INCREMENTAL`, `FD_SSMSG_DONE`, and `FD_SSMSG_EXPECTED_SLOT`, and it provides helper functions to extract or build the low bits of a message and to split or join a slot number for fragment storage. The file also defines the data structures that describe snapshot content, including vote accounts, stake delegations, epoch stake data, inflation and epoch schedule parameters, fee and rent settings, blockhash data, and the full `fd_snapshot_manifest` record. These types are used to carry chain state and configuration data during snapshot restore and validation.
